t_advice_summary_textbox.text: gnomes will come out in different colours and each colours lead you to different forest depending on the colour. The aim is to collect as much mushroom as you can irrespective of the gnome you pick

vb_textbox.text: Hello this is my advice which is brief and the game is really all that not complicated. Pick a gnome and any would do irrespective of the colour or size. You are then taking into the forest where you will fill up your basket with mushroom by simply pressing the space button.
